role_summary: Monitors, investigates and responds to security threats: alert triage, incident analysis, vulnerability management and security tooling.

postings.title: Senior SOC Analyst
postings.summary: Security operations analyst monitoring alerts, investigating incidents and phishing, and responding according to established procedures.
responsibilities: Monitor security alerts and events for threats
Detect, analyse and scope security incidents across tools
Respond to incidents following established procedures
requirements: 3+ years in a security operations centre
Bachelor's in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, IT or similar
Familiarity with SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls and antivirus tools
Understanding of networks, operating systems and endpoints

postings.title: Intermediate Security Analyst, Vulnerability Operations
postings.summary: Vulnerability operations analyst triaging bug bounty reports and vulnerabilities, assessing severity and coordinating disclosure and fixes.
responsibilities: Triage bug bounty reports and validate findings
Track vulnerabilities from assessment to remediation
Assess severity using CVE, CVSS, CWE and OWASP
Write runbooks and coordinate customer-facing security communications
requirements: Early-career experience or equivalent education in cybersecurity or software
Foundational knowledge of web application and API vulnerabilities
